title: Home and first request design conflicts
rule: Home starts truly empty and never seeds example decks. Recents and All decks show only owned decks; Starred is retired. New deck opens an empty editor with its first-request field. Preserve the first pending request across sign-in and deck creation. Before P08, save that request with explicit pending copy and never simulate Aira drafting. Phone deck routes are read-only and say Edit on a laptop.
alternatives: Keep Starred alongside Recents and All decks.
Start simulated drafting when a request is stored before P08.

examples.expect: Home has no deck cards and offers New deck and Import PowerPoint.
The request is saved as pending; no run or generated slides are claimed.

counterexamples.reject: Displaying seeded deck cards as owned decks.
Showing Aira is drafting without an actual run.
